# https://www.steelers.com/draft/draft-tracker
## Round 1

##  Round 1  
Pick 21  (21)  
###  Derrick Harmon  
DT  Oregon  
6-4  313 LBS  
* **2021 (Michigan State):** Redshirted. Played in 4 games as a reserve (1 tackle).
* **2022 (Michigan State):** Played in all 12 games with 5 starts (30 tackles, 3 TFLs with 2 sacks, PBU).
* **2023 (Michigan State):** Played in all 12 games with 10 starts (40 tackles, 3.5 TFLs with 1.5 sacks, PBU, FF).
* **2024:** Second-team Associated Press All-American. Third-team All-Big Ten Conference. Tied for the team lead with 2 FFs. Played all 14 games with 13 starts (45 tackles, 10.5 TFLs with 5 sacks, 4 PBUs, 2 FFs).  
_\-- by Chad Reuter_

# https://www.steelers.com/draft/draft-tracker
## Round 3

##  Round 3  
Pick 19  (83)  
###  Kaleb Johnson  
RB  Iowa  
6-1  224 LBS  
* **2022:** Honorable Mention All-Big Ten Conference. Led team with 779 rushing yards, 6 rushing TDs (151 carries, 5.2 per). Played in all 13 games with 6 starts (4-27-6.8 receiving; 13-325-25.0 KR).
* **2023:** Played in 10 games with 5 starts (117-463-4.0, 3 TDs rushing; 3-25-8.3 receiving; 2-77-38.5 KR)). Missed 3 games due to injury.
* **2024:** Second-team Associated Press All-American. Big Ten RB of the Year. First-team All-Big Ten. Finalist for the Doak Walker Award (nation's top RB). Ranked sixth in the FBS with 138 points scored, tied for sixth with a school-record 21 rushing TDs, ranked seventh with 1,537 rushing yards (240 carries, 6.4 per), eighth with 1,725 all-purpose yards (22-188-8.5, 2 TDs receiving). Set school record with 23 total TDs. Played in 12 games with 11 starts. Did not play in the team's Music City Bowl loss to Missouri.  
_\-- by Chad Reuter_

# https://www.steelers.com/draft/draft-tracker
## Round 4

##  Round 4  
Pick 21  (123)  
###  Jack Sawyer  
EDGE  Ohio State  
6-4  260 LBS  
* **High school:** 5-star recruit, top 5 overall prospect nationally.
* **2021:** Played in 12 games as a reserve (13 tackles, 3 sacks, PBU, FF).
* **2022:** Honorable Mention All-Big Ten Conference. Played in all 13 games with 3 starts (24 tackles, 6.5 TFLs with 4.5 sacks, PBU).
* **2023:** Third-team All-Big Ten. Led team with 6.5 sacks. Tied for the team lead with 10 TFLs, 2 FFs. Started all 13 games (48 tackles, 2 PBUs, 2 FFs).
* **2024:** Second-team All-Big Ten. Tied for the team lead with 3 FFs. Team captain. Cotton Bowl Defensive MVP (game-clinching 83-yard TD in the fourth quarter after causing and recovering a fumble on a sack of Texas QB Quinn Ewers). Started all 16 games for the national champions (59 tackles, 9 sacks, INT, 6 PBUs).  
_\-- by Chad Reuter_

# https://www.steelers.com/draft/draft-tracker
## Round 6

##  Round 6  
Pick 9  (185)  
###  Will Howard  
QB  Ohio State  
6-4  236 LBS  
From Bears through Seahawks  
* **High school:** Maxwell Club Pennsylvania Player of the Year (2,543 yards, 27 TDs passing).
* **2020 (Kansas State):** Played in 9 games with 7 starts (90-168-53.6, 1,178 yards, 8 TDs, 10 INTs passing; 78-364-4.7, 3 TDs rushing).
* **2021 (Kansas State):** Played in 6 games with 3 starts (30-55-54.5, 332 yards, TD, INT passing; 32-184-5.8, 4 TDs rushing).
* **2022 (Kansas State):** Played in 7 games with 5 starts (119-199-59.8, 1,633 yards, 15 TDs, 4 INTs passing; 35-22-0.6, 3 TDs rushing).
* **2023 (Kansas State):** Second-team All-Big 12 Conference. Started 12 games (219-357-61.3, 2,643 yards, 24 TDs, 10 INTs passing; 81-351-4.3, 9 TDs rushing). Set school record with 48 career passing TDs. Entered the transfer portal after the regular season.

## Round 6

* **2024:** Third-team All-Big Ten Conference. Ranked second in the FBS with 73.0 completion percentage (309-423), fourth with 35 passing TDs (10 INTs), sixth with 4,010 passing yards. Cotton Bowl Offensive MVP (24-33, 289 yards, TD, INT) in the win over Texas. National Championship Offensive MVP (231 yards, 2 TDs passing; 16-57 rushing). Started all 16 games for the national champions (105-226-2.2, 7 TDs rushing).  
_\-- by Chad Reuter_

* **2023:** Honorable Mention All-Pac-12 Conference. Teamâs Special Teams MVP. Played in all 15 games with 1 start (86 tackles, 2.5 TFLs, INT, 3 PBUs, FF).
